draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.42, the 21st-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 3rd of 20 at DE. He went 28th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Antwan Odom. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (91st percentile). College production: 6 sacks in 2022, 10th of 19 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Cincinnati Bengals. 47 career games and 10 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (5 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: season snap share 62.6% (78th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 edge rusher who played: 5.5 sacks against a median of 2.0, above the norm.
